tasks.spec: Reads active_holdings + latest_prices + price_history. current value, gain/loss, weight, allocation (asset class + geography), XIRR (reuse services.calculations.xirr), concentration score, fund overlap matrix. Bonds/other with price None are EXCLUDED from value totals and returned in a separate 'excluded' list â€” never counted as 0. rolling_returns/drawdown/portfolio_vs_benchmark helpers each return {'state':'ok'|'partial'|'pending', 'series':[...]} â€” 'pending' when no price_history rows for the symbols, 'partial' when < requested window.

APIRouter, every Investments endpoint in master doc section 7: /investments/holdings (+ {id} GET/PUT/DELETE, {id}/archive), /investments/quality, all /investments/visuals/* (asset-allocation, geography, target-vs-actual, portfolio-vs-benchmark, rolling-returns, drawdown, treemap, fund-overlap, expense-ratio, sip-calendar, concentration), /investments/research/{holding_id}. {id} DELETE -> 409 'use archive' unless the holding has zero lots. visuals that use price_history return the state discriminator from portfolio.py.

HoldingsAnalyzer, QualityChecker (regular-plan flag, high TER, concentration, overlap), AllocationDrift (actual vs target). __init__(self, llm_client). Deterministic dict output; llm_client only renders the narrative. No module-level LLM import.

Holdings table (edit + archive inline via useSubmit; the hard-delete button is RENDERED only when holding.lots_count === 0), a Quality panel, a research drawer, and the visuals. Each visual reads its endpoint's {state} and renders a distinct 'Backfill pending' / 'Partial history' message for pending/partial â€” not a blank 'no data'. Fetch via useFinanceData.

Hand-rolled SVG charts (no chart lib): AllocationDonut, RollingReturnsLine, DrawdownArea, ConcentrationBar, TreemapGrid. Each takes a data series and COMPUTES the path (index->x, value->y via min/max; polyline = one M then L per point). prefers-reduced-motion guard on any animation. A 3D AllocationPucks via @react-three/fiber lazy ssr:false is optional; the SVG donut is the baseline.
